Class TwoDimensionalCorrelationSpectrum

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.Spectrum
global.thalion.ttio.TwoDimensionalCorrelationSpectrum
public class TwoDimensionalCorrelationSpectrum extends Spectrum
2D correlation spectrum (Noda 2D-COS): synchronous + asynchronous rank-2 correlation matrices sharing a single spectral-variable axis (ν1 = ν2). Both matrices are stored row-major as flat double[] of length size × size.

API status: Stable (v0.11.1).

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIOTwoDimensionalCorrelationSpectrum, Python ttio.two_dimensional_correlation_spectrum.TwoDimensionalCorrelationSpectrum.

  • Constructor Details

    • TwoDimensionalCorrelationSpectrum

      public TwoDimensionalCorrelationSpectrum(double[] synchronousMatrix, double[] asynchronousMatrix, int size, AxisDescriptor variableAxis, String perturbation, String perturbationUnit, String sourceModality)
      Construct a 2D-COS spectrum from synchronous and asynchronous correlation matrices computed by TwoDCos.
      Parameters:
      synchronousMatrix - row-major size × size matrix of synchronous correlations
      asynchronousMatrix - row-major size × size matrix of asynchronous correlations
      size - side length of both matrices
      variableAxis - axis descriptor for the shared variable dimension
      perturbation - perturbation name (e.g. "temperature"); null becomes empty
      perturbationUnit - perturbation unit (e.g. "K"); null becomes empty
      sourceModality - source modality label (e.g. "IR", "Raman"); null becomes empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when either matrix is null or the matrix lengths don't equal size*size
